widget.name: AGGrid
widget.description: Data grid powered by AG Grid Community: sorting, filtering, set filters, quick search, pagination, inline editing, selection, cell ranges with fill handle and charts, row grouping, pivot mode, tree data, side panel, Excel and CSV export, totals and themes.

property.caption: Data source
property.description: The objects shown as rows.

property.caption: Data loading
property.description: Browser: all rows are loaded once and sorted, filtered and paged in the browser (fast interaction, best up to some thousands of rows). Server: the data source pages, sorts and filters like Data Grid 2, so any number of rows works; quick search, floating filters and header sorting are sent to the data source.

property.caption: Max rows to load
property.description: Browser loading only: maximum number of objects retrieved from the data source. 0 loads all objects.

property.caption: Refresh time (seconds)
property.description: Reloads the data source every given number of seconds. 0 disables automatic refresh.

property.caption: Columns
property.description: The columns of the grid.

property.caption: Show
property.description: Attribute: value of an attribute (sortable, filterable, editable). Dynamic text: an expression per row. Custom content: any widgets per row.

property.caption: Attribute
property.description: The attribute shown in this column.

property.caption: Dynamic text
property.description: Text shown in this column, evaluated per row.

property.caption: Custom content
property.description: Widgets rendered in this column for every row.

property.caption: Caption
property.description: Column header. Defaults to the attribute name.

property.caption: Header group
property.description: Adjacent columns with the same header group text are grouped under one spanning header.

property.caption: Tooltip
property.description: Tooltip shown when hovering a cell, evaluated per row.

property.caption: Render as
property.description: Text shows the formatted value. Link opens the value as a URL in a new tab. Badge shows the value as an Atlas badge (add a cell class such as 'badge-success' to color it). Progress shows a numeric value between 0 and 100 as a bar. Image shows the value as an image URL. Sparkline draws a small trend line from a text value with numbers separated by commas or spaces (for example 3,5,4,8,7).

property.caption: Attribute name (editing)
property.description: Only needed for inline editing when the widget cannot tell which attribute to write (all loaded rows have the same value in several attributes of the same type). Enter the attribute name, e.g. Department.

property.caption: Total from data source
property.description: Attribute of the totals data source (Appearance > Totals row) shown in the totals row for this column. Used when 'Totals from' is set to 'Data source'.

property.caption: Width
property.description: Flex shares the free space in proportion to the flex value. Fixed uses the pixel width. Auto sizes to the content when the grid loads.

property.caption: Flex
property.description: Relative share of the free width.

property.caption: Width (px)
property.description: Fixed column width in pixels.

property.caption: Min width (px)
property.description: 0 uses the grid default.

property.caption: Max width (px)
property.description: 0 means no maximum.

property.caption: Sortable
property.description: Click the header to sort. Hold Shift (or see 'Multi sort') to sort on several columns.

property.caption: Filter
property.description: Filter shown in the column menu and as floating filter. Auto picks text, number or date from the attribute type. Set shows a checklist of the distinct values with search, (Select all) and (Blanks); with Server data loading it is used for enumeration and boolean attributes (other types fall back to a text filter).

property.caption: Editable
property.description: Whether cells in this column can be edited, evaluated per row. Attribute columns only. Values are written to the attribute immediately.

property.caption: Pinned
property.description: Keeps the column visible while scrolling horizontally.

property.caption: Visible
property.description: Hides the column when false.

property.caption: Resizable
property.description: Lets the user drag the header edge to resize the column.

property.caption: Movable
property.description: Lets the user drag the header to reorder columns.

property.caption: Totals row value
property.description: Value shown for this column in the totals row (see Appearance > Totals row). Calculated over the rows that pass the current filter.

property.caption: Top totals row value
property.description: Only used when Appearance > Totals row is 'Top and bottom': the value shown for this column in the top totals row. 'Same' repeats the Totals row value.

property.caption: Pivot start role
property.description: Only used when Features > Pivot > Pivot mode is on: the role of this column in the pivot layout the grid starts with. Users change the layout in the side panel.

property.caption: Pivot value function
property.description: Aggregation used when this column is a pivot value. Sum and average need a number column, minimum and maximum a number or date column; count and distinct count work for every column.

property.caption: Users can pivot on this column
property.description: Lets users use this column as row group, column label or value in pivot mode. Custom content columns can never be pivoted.

property.caption: Group by level
property.description: Only used when Features > Grouping > Row grouping is on. 0 = the grid is not grouped by this column when it opens; 1, 2 or 3 = grouped by this column at that level (1 is the outermost group). Users can change the grouping with the Group by menu.

property.caption: Users can group by this column
property.description: Lists the column in the toolbar Group by menu (Features > Grouping). Custom content columns can never be grouped.

property.caption: Validation
property.description: Evaluated per row: return an error message when the cell value is invalid, or an empty text when it is valid. Example: if $currentObject/Salary < 0 then 'Salary cannot be negative' else ''. Invalid cells get an error outline and tooltip, and the toolbar shows an issues badge that jumps to the next invalid cell (F8).

property.caption: Alignment
property.description: Auto right-aligns numbers and centers booleans.

property.caption: Decimal precision
property.description: Number of decimals shown for numeric attributes. -1 keeps the default Mendix formatting.

property.caption: Group digits
property.description: Shows thousands separators for numeric attributes.

property.caption: Wrap text
property.description: Wraps long values instead of clipping them. Combine with 'Auto row height'.

property.caption: Auto row height
property.description: Rows grow to fit the content of this column.

property.caption: Conditional format
property.description: Spreadsheet-style formatting of number columns, scaled between the lowest and highest loaded value. Data bar: a bar behind the value. Color scale: a background from red (low) over yellow to green (high). Icon set: an up, flat or down arrow for the top, middle and bottom third.

property.caption: Data bar color
property.description: CSS color of the data bars, for example #0ea58f. Empty uses the grid accent color.

property.caption: Lower is better
property.description: Reverses the color scale and the icon set, for columns where a low value is good (costs, durations).

property.caption: Cell class
property.description: CSS class(es) added to the cell, evaluated per row. Use for conditional formatting.

property.caption: On click
property.description: Runs when a cell in this column is clicked.

property.caption: On change
property.description: Runs after an edited value in this column is written to the attribute. The variables New value and Old value hold the values as text.

property.caption: Selection
property.description: Whether the user can select one row, several rows, or none.

property.caption: Selection checkboxes
property.description: Shows a checkbox column for selecting rows.

property.caption: Select all checkbox
property.description: Shows a checkbox in the header that selects or deselects all (filtered) rows. Multi selection only.

property.caption: Select on row click
property.description: Clicking a row selects it. Ctrl/Cmd-click and Shift-click extend a multi selection.

property.caption: Quick search
property.description: Shows a search box above the grid that filters all columns.

property.caption: Search placeholder
property.description: Placeholder text shown in the empty search box.

property.caption: Search attribute
property.description: Optional String attribute that holds the quick search text, so another widget (for example a text box) can drive the search.

property.caption: Export button
property.description: Downloads the filtered and sorted rows. With server data loading all matching rows are fetched first (up to 50,000).

property.caption: Export format
property.description: Excel (.xlsx with real numbers, dates and booleans, bold header, frozen header row and auto filter), CSV, or a button for each.

property.caption: Excel sheets
property.description: Data and more: the Data sheet plus a Pivot sheet while the pivot table is shown and a Selection sheet while a cell range is selected. Data only: one sheet, as in version 1.2.

property.caption: Styled Excel
property.description: Header fill color, column widths as shown in the grid, frozen pinned columns, the columns' conditional formats as native Excel data bars, color scales and icon sets, and the totals row as SUBTOTAL formulas. Off writes the plain 1.2 layout.

property.caption: Export file name
property.description: File name without the extension. Also used as the Excel sheet name.

property.caption: Reset button
property.description: Clears filters, sorting and restores the column layout.

property.caption: Refresh button
property.description: Reloads the data source.

property.caption: Columns button
property.description: Lets the user show and hide columns. The choice is kept in the column state attribute when one is configured.

property.caption: Selection count
property.description: Shows how many rows are selected and a button to clear the selection.

property.caption: Density button
property.description: Adds a toolbar button that switches the rows between compact, normal and comfortable spacing. The choice is remembered with the layout (Remember layout in) and in saved views.

property.caption: Keyboard help button
property.description: Shows a button with a popover that lists the keyboard shortcuts of the grid (also opened with Shift+? while a cell has focus).

property.caption: Multi sort without Shift
property.description: Clicking several headers sorts on all of them. When off, hold Shift to add a column to the sort.

property.caption: Floating filters
property.description: Shows a filter input under each column header.

property.caption: Pagination
property.description: Shows the loaded rows in pages with a pager under the grid.

property.caption: Page size
property.description: Number of rows per page.

property.caption: Page size choices
property.description: Comma-separated page sizes the user can pick. Leave empty to hide the selector.

property.caption: Auto page size
property.description: Fits as many rows per page as the grid height allows (fixed height layout only).

property.caption: Edit mode
property.description: Cell edits one cell at a time. Full row puts every editable cell of the row in edit mode.

property.caption: Single click edit
property.description: Starts editing on a single click instead of a double click.

property.caption: Commit
property.description: What happens after a cell is edited. Keep in client: the change stays in the client until a Save button or another commit persists it. Commit directly: the widget saves the object. Run On commit action: the changed object is passed to the On commit action (a microflow or nanoflow that validates and commits).

property.caption: On commit
property.description: Runs with the changed object after an inline edit when Commit is 'Run On commit action'. Receives the variables New value, Old value and Attribute name.

property.caption: Undo / redo
property.description: Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y undo and redo cell edits made in this grid.

property.caption: Enter moves down
property.description: Enter moves to the cell below (like a spreadsheet) instead of staying on the cell.

property.caption: Flash changed cells
property.description: Briefly highlights a cell when its value changes.

property.caption: Paste from Excel
property.description: Ctrl+V pastes copied cells (for example a block copied from Excel or another grid) into the editable cells, starting at the focused cell and going down and to the right. Values that do not fit a column (text in a number column) are skipped. Ctrl+Z undoes the whole paste.

property.caption: Hold commits while invalid
property.description: With Commit set to 'Commit directly' or 'Run On commit action': a changed object is not committed, and On commit does not run, while one of its cells fails a column Validation expression (or Mendix validation). The held commit runs automatically as soon as the object is valid again.

property.caption: Auto size
property.description: Fit grid width scales columns to fill the grid. Fit cell contents sizes each column to its content.

property.caption: Remember layout in
property.description: Where column order, widths, pinning, visibility, sorting, filters and the search text are remembered. Browser storage needs no entity and is kept per browser. Attribute stores it in a String attribute of the page context object, so it can be persisted per user.

property.caption: Layout attribute
property.description: String attribute that remembers the layout when 'Remember layout in' is 'Attribute'. Store it on a persistent object to keep the layout between sessions.

property.caption: Row grouping
property.description: Groups rows by the values of one to three columns, with a Group by toolbar menu, collapsible group rows, row counts and the column aggregates (column Totals row value) per group. Set the starting grouping per column with 'Group by level'. Browser data loading only.

property.caption: Groups start expanded
property.description: Show the rows of every group when the grid opens; off starts with all groups collapsed.

property.caption: Lazy server groups
property.description: Server data loading only: users can group by one enumeration or boolean column. Each group shows its row count (one small request per group) and its rows are loaded page by page from the data source when the group is expanded. Rows inside lazily loaded groups are read-only.

property.caption: Hide grouped columns
property.description: Hides a column while the grid is grouped by it (its value is already shown in the group row).

property.caption: Status bar
property.description: A bar under the grid with the number of shown, total and selected rows and, for every column with a Totals row value, the sum, average, minimum, maximum or count of the selected rows (of all shown rows when nothing is selected). The numbers update live and count up smoothly.

property.caption: Pivot mode
property.description: Browser data loading only. Users switch the grid to a pivot table with the Pivot toolbar button or in the side panel: row groups, column labels and value columns with sum, average, count, minimum, maximum or distinct count, subtotals, a row total column and a grand total row. The pivot follows the filters and the quick search, is kept in saved views and is exported as its own Excel sheet. Set the starting layout per column with 'Pivot start role'.

property.caption: Start in pivot mode
property.description: Opens the grid as a pivot table with the layout from the columns' 'Pivot start role'.

property.caption: Pivot totals
property.description: Shows a total column per value at the end of the pivot and a grand total row at the bottom.

property.caption: Tree data
property.description: Browser data loading only. Shows the rows as a hierarchy. Key and parent key: every row has a key and the key of its parent (for example over an association). Path: every row has a path such as Europe/Norway/Oslo; missing levels are added as summary rows.

property.caption: Key
property.description: Unique key of the row, for example toString($currentObject/Code). Used with 'Key and parent key'.

property.caption: Parent key
property.description: Key of the parent row, empty for top-level rows. It can follow an association, for example $currentObject/MyModule.Task_Parent/MyModule.Task/Code. Used with 'Key and parent key'.

property.caption: Path
property.description: Path of the row from the top level, the parts separated by the path separator, for example $currentObject/Region + '/' + $currentObject/Country + '/' + $currentObject/City. Used with 'Path'.

property.caption: Path separator
property.description: Text that separates the parts of the path.

property.caption: Label
property.description: Text shown next to the chevron in the tree column. Empty uses the last part of the path, or the key.

property.caption: Open levels
property.description: Number of levels that are open when the grid loads: 0 shows only the top level, 1 also shows its children, -1 opens everything.

property.caption: Aggregate per parent
property.description: Parent rows show the column 'Totals row value' (sum, average, ...) of all their descendants instead of their own value. Generated path levels always show the aggregates.

property.caption: Cell range selection
property.description: Users select a block of cells by dragging, with Shift+click or with Shift+arrow keys. Ctrl+C copies the range as tab-separated text (pastes into Excel), and the status bar shows the count, sum and average of the range.

property.caption: Fill handle
property.description: A handle at the bottom right of the range copies its values down or right, or continues a linear series (1, 2, 3 or dates). Ctrl+D fills down from the first row of the range. Writes through the normal editing and commit path; one Ctrl+Z undoes the fill.

property.caption: Chart range
property.description: A toolbar button (and Alt+F1) that draws a bar, line or pie chart of the selected range: the first text column gives the categories, every number column a series.

property.caption: Side panel
property.description: A toolbar button opens a panel next to the grid with a Columns section (show, hide, reorder, search, and drop zones for row groups, pivot column labels and values) and a Filters section. Whether it is open and which section is shown is kept in saved views.

property.caption: Start open
property.description: Opens the side panel when the page loads.

property.caption: Views menu
property.description: Shows a Views menu in the toolbar. Users save the current layout (column order, widths, visibility, pinning, sorting, filters and search text) under a name, switch between named views, rename or delete them, and mark one as the default view that opens when the page loads.

property.caption: Views attribute
property.description: Optional String attribute (use unlimited length) of a context object that stores the saved views as JSON, for example on a persistent per-user object so views follow the user across browsers. When empty, the views are kept in the browser's local storage.

property.caption: Browser storage key
property.description: Key under which the views are kept in browser local storage when no views attribute is set. Grids with the same key share their views. Leave empty to use the widget name.

property.caption: Detail content
property.description: Widgets shown in an expandable full-width row under a row, for that row's object. When set, a chevron column expands and collapses the detail row. Browser data loading only.

property.caption: Expand
property.description: One row at a time: expanding a row collapses the previously expanded row. Several rows: every row expands independently.

property.caption: Start collapsed
property.description: When off, the first row (one row at a time) or every row (several rows) starts expanded.

property.caption: Detail height (px)
property.description: Height of a detail row in pixels; taller content scrolls. 0 fits the height of the content.

property.caption: Row drag
property.description: Shows a drag handle in the first column so rows can be reordered. Without pagination rows move while dragging; with pagination the row is dropped on the hovered row. Disable sorting and filtering for a predictable order.

property.caption: Order attribute
property.description: After a drop the new position (starting at 1) is written to this attribute of every row. Sort the data source on it to keep the order.

property.caption: Theme
property.description: Atlas matches the look of Data Grid 2 (app font, white header, thin row lines, Data Grid 2 style paging). The AG Grid themes can be combined with a light or dark color scheme.

property.caption: Color scheme
property.description: Auto follows the browser or operating system preference.

property.caption: Accent color
property.description: CSS color used for selection, focus and checkboxes, e.g. #264AE5. Leave empty for the theme default.

property.caption: Font size (px)
property.description: 0 uses the theme default.

property.caption: Spacing (px)
property.description: Base padding used by the theme. Smaller values give a denser grid. 0 uses the theme default.

property.caption: Height
property.description: Fixed height scrolls rows inside the grid. Auto height grows with the rows. Print renders every row without scrollbars.

property.caption: Grid height
property.description: CSS height for the fixed height layout, e.g. 500px or 70vh.

property.caption: Row height (px)
property.description: 0 uses the theme default.

property.caption: Header height (px)
property.description: 0 uses the theme default.

property.caption: Wrap header text
property.description: Wraps long captions and grows the header to fit.

property.caption: Row numbers
property.description: Adds a pinned first column with the row number.

property.caption: Animate rows
property.description: Animates rows when sorting, filtering or paging.

property.caption: Lively effects
property.description: Skeleton rows while the data loads, a slim progress bar while it refreshes, a highlight on rows that changed after a data refresh, an animated empty state with a Clear filters button, and soft toolbar and menu transitions. Animations are always skipped for users who prefer reduced motion.

property.caption: Motion
property.description: Full: every animation of Lively effects plus count-up numbers and group transitions. Subtle: fades only, without row movement, flashes or count-ups. Off: no animation at all. Users who prefer reduced motion always get Off.

property.caption: Highlight search matches
property.description: Marks the text that matches the quick search in the visible cells (browsers without the CSS Custom Highlight API simply show no marks).

property.caption: Highlight row on hover
property.description: Highlights the row under the mouse pointer.

property.caption: Highlight column on hover
property.description: Highlights the column under the mouse pointer.

property.caption: Allow text selection
property.description: Lets the user select and copy cell text with the mouse.

property.caption: Row class
property.description: CSS class(es) added to the row, evaluated per row.

property.caption: Totals row
property.description: Shows a pinned row with the values configured per column under 'Totals row value'. 'Top and bottom' shows two rows; the top row uses the column 'Top totals row value'. The values always follow the filters and the quick search.

property.caption: Users can change totals
property.description: Clicking a totals cell (or Enter on it) opens a menu to show the sum, average, minimum, maximum, count or distinct count of that column, or nothing. The choice is kept with the layout and in saved views. Totals from loaded rows only.

property.caption: Totals label
property.description: Shown in the first column of the totals row when that column has no value of its own.

property.caption: Totals from
property.description: Loaded rows calculates the per-column 'Totals row value' over the rows in the browser (the filtered rows, or the loaded page with server data loading). Data source shows attributes of the first object of the totals data source, so a microflow can aggregate over all rows on the server.

property.caption: Totals data source
property.description: Data source (typically a microflow returning one non-persistable object) whose first object holds the totals; map its attributes per column with 'Total from data source'.

property.caption: Columns button label
property.description: Text of the Columns button.

property.caption: Refresh button label
property.description: Text of the Refresh button.

property.caption: Reset button label
property.description: Text of the Reset button.

property.caption: Excel button label
property.description: Text of the Export Excel button.

property.caption: CSV button label
property.description: Text of the Export CSV button.

property.caption: Selection count text
property.description: Text next to the selection; [count] is replaced by the number of selected rows.

property.caption: Clear selection label
property.description: Text of the button that clears the selection.

property.caption: Page size label
property.description: Label of the page size selector in the Atlas pager.

property.caption: Paging status text
property.description: Text in the Atlas pager; [first], [last] and [total] are replaced by the row numbers.

property.caption: Views button label
property.description: Text of the Views menu button.

property.caption: Save view label
property.description: Text of the Views menu item that saves the current layout as a new view.

property.caption: Issues badge text
property.description: Text of the toolbar badge shown while cells fail validation; [count] is replaced by the number of invalid cells.

property.caption: Show details label
property.description: Accessible label of the chevron button that expands a detail row.

property.caption: Clear filters label
property.description: Text of the button in the animated empty state that clears the filters and the search text.

property.caption: Group by label
property.description: Text of the toolbar Group by menu button.

property.caption: Group column header
property.description: Header of the column that shows the group rows.

property.caption: Density label
property.description: Accessible label of the density toolbar button.

property.caption: Status bar rows text
property.description: Row counter of the status bar; [shown] is replaced by the rows that pass the filters and [total] by all loaded rows.

property.caption: Side panel label
property.description: Text of the toolbar button that opens the side panel.

property.caption: Pivot button label
property.description: Text of the toolbar button that switches pivot mode on and off.

property.caption: Pivot total label
property.description: Header of the pivot total columns and label of the grand total row.

property.caption: Tree column header
property.description: Header of the column that shows the hierarchy (Tree data).

property.caption: Chart range label
property.description: Text of the toolbar button that charts the selected cell range.

property.caption: Save failed text
property.description: Message shown when changes could not be saved; [count] is replaced by the number of changes.

property.caption: Retry label
property.description: Text of the button that retries failed saves, and of the button that redraws the grid after an error.

property.caption: Discard label
property.description: Text of the button that undoes changes that could not be saved.

property.caption: Error text
property.description: Message shown instead of the grid when it ran into an unexpected error.

translations.translation: The grid ran into a problem and was stopped.

property.caption: Keyboard help label
property.description: Accessible label and title of the keyboard help button and popover.

property.caption: No rows text
property.description: Message shown when the data source returns no objects or every row is filtered out.

property.caption: Empty placeholder
property.description: Widgets shown instead of the grid body when the data source returns no objects.

property.caption: On row click
property.description: Runs when a row is clicked. A column 'On click' action takes precedence for its cells.

property.caption: On row double click
property.description: Runs when a row is double clicked.

property.caption: On selection change
property.description: Runs after the selection changed.

property.caption: On cell value change
property.description: Runs after any edited value is written to its attribute. Column 'On change' actions run first. The variables New value and Old value hold the values as text.

property.caption: On group by change
property.description: Runs after the user changed the grouping. The variable Group by holds the captions of the grouped columns, outermost first, separated by ' > ' (empty when ungrouped).

property.caption: On paste
property.description: Runs once after a paste (Features > Editing > Paste from Excel) wrote its values. The variable Cell count holds the number of cells that were changed.

property.caption: On fill
property.description: Runs once after the fill handle (or Ctrl+D) wrote its values. The variable Cell count holds the number of cells that were changed.

property.caption: On row drag end
property.description: Runs after rows were reordered by dragging. The order attribute is already updated when this runs.
